Digital letter · Project brief
Concept project · Social media

The Strategy Behind Abante

01

About the Project

ABANTE is a concept motorcycle ride-booking service designed to provide commuters with a convenient, affordable, and time-saving transportation option. The service allows customers to book motorcycle rides for daily commutes, errands, urgent appointments, and other local trips.

The brand focuses on helping people navigate busy streets, avoid crowded public transportation, and reach their destinations more conveniently.

This project demonstrates how strategic social media content can introduce a local service, communicate its value, and build brand awareness online.

02

Project Goals

  1. Build Brand Awareness: Introduce ABANTE and establish its identity as a convenient transportation option.
  2. Communicate Value: Highlight the benefits of motorcycle rides, including convenience, affordability, and maneuverability in traffic.
  3. Encourage Inquiries: Motivate potential customers to send direct messages to ask about the service and booking process.
03

Target Audience

ABANTE is designed for commuters and individuals who value convenience, affordability, and flexibility in their daily transportation.

Primary audience:

  1. Daily commuters traveling to work or school.
  2. Professionals with busy schedules and time-sensitive appointments.
  3. Individuals running errands or traveling to nearby destinations.
  4. Commuters looking for an alternative to crowded public transportation.
04

Content Strategy

The content strategy focuses on communicating ABANTE’s value through clear, relatable, and engaging social media posts.

Content is designed to highlight common commuting challenges, such as heavy traffic, crowded public transportation, and the need to arrive on time, while positioning ABANTE as a convenient alternative for local trips.

The goal is to create content that captures attention, communicates practical benefits, and encourages potential customers to consider the service.

05

Content Pillars

Content PillarPurposeExample Content
Problem & SolutionConnect with common commuting struggles“Late na naman dahil sa traffic?”
Service PromotionIntroduce ABANTE’s servicesHow to book a ride with ABANTE
Benefits & ConvenienceCommunicate the value of the serviceA more convenient option for short local trips
Relatable ContentBuild engagement through everyday experiencesFunny or relatable commuter situations
Brand AwarenessMake the business recognizableABANTE’s brand introduction, mission, and tagline
06

Caption & SEO Strategy

Captions are written to connect with everyday commuters while communicating the brand’s key benefits.

The strategy includes:

  • Using relevant transportation and motorcycle ride-booking keywords.
  • Incorporating location-specific keywords where appropriate.
  • Writing clear, engaging captions that address commuter pain points.
  • Including relevant hashtags to support content discovery.
  • Adding compelling calls to action to encourage inquiries and engagement.
07

Call-to-Action Strategy

Each promotional post encourages potential customers to take the next step, whether by sending a direct message, asking about the service, or inquiring about booking a ride.

The goal is to turn social media attention into meaningful customer inquiries.

08

Success Metrics (KPIs)

These are the metrics I would track to measure performance, not just publish attractive posts.

  • Reach: How many unique accounts see ABANTE’s content.
  • Engagement: Likes, comments, shares, and saves.
  • Profile Visits: How many people visit the Instagram profile.
  • Direct Messages: How many potential customers inquire about bookings.
  • Booking Conversions: How many inquiries result in confirmed rides.

ABANTE is a sample business, so these are proposed KPIs, not actual results.
